SimulationCraft publishes no rotation for most healing specs (Discipline, Holy Priest, Holy Paladin, Mistweaver, Restoration Shaman, Preservation). For those DMGAssist has its own damage lists, learned from the current class guides, for your damage between heals (SimC's list replaces ours as soon as it publishes one). Healing stays your call. Interrupts, defensives with your boss mod, on-use trinkets, keybinds and your spell choices all work. Restoration Druid has a full SimC list, including cat weaving. A spec with no list at all (some on WoW Forever) follows Blizzard's Assisted Combat.
